items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Then, we got together and I signed a contract to take a band on this show. With the backing of Annole Matoia... C.W. Parks.

ctx.x: He played with Ory and Mud Carey and some of that. Yeah, that's right.

He played with Ory and Mud Carey there. But he didn't depend on music too much because he was a decorator. He decorated. But he was a very independent little fellow. He bought a home there, see, in the Uptown, up by Protection Levy. And that band, I stayed with that band two years and seven months. Armand J.P. Rons band, until P. Rons got a job at the St. Charles Hotel. And he took four pieces, or five pieces over there, and turned this band over to me. But he didn't take no man out of this band. He used all…
